svg.desc: All twelve targets and six public method columns at final phase-aligned operator-error tolerance 1e-6. Lizzy is its measured automatic exact selector; Qiskit formulas include default/Rustiq lowering, not an extra compiler brand. Separate internal BDI, Givens and Wei-Norman diagnostics remain in the complete measurement record. Numbers are actual T plus T-dagger counts. Shared logarithmic colors show each count divided by the lowest passing count for that target, not a global ranking.
